game.title: Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
game.blurb: Remake of the 2006 open-world RPG from Bethesda Game Studios and Virtuos, released 2025-04-22. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours (undercounts a full playthrough). Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters follow the questline structure listed on UESP.

chapters.title: The Main Quest
chapters.summary: From the Imperial Prison sewers to the end of the Oblivion Crisis.

chapters.title: Fighters Guild
chapters.summary: Join the guild and climb its ranks.

chapters.title: Mages Guild
chapters.summary: Earn recommendations from each city, then rise to Arch-Mage.

chapters.title: Thieves Guild
chapters.summary: Find the guild and work up to Guildmaster.

chapters.title: Dark Brotherhood
chapters.summary: The assassins' questline, rank by rank.

chapters.title: The Arena
chapters.summary: Fight your way from Pit Dog to Grand Champion in the Imperial City.

chapters.title: Daedric Shrines and Side Quests
chapters.summary: Daedric Princes' quests and the many town and wilderness side quests.

chapters.title: Shivering Isles
chapters.summary: The realm of madness expansion and the Court of Madness ranks.

notes: Route cc-by-sa: UESP (en.uesp.net, CC BY-SA 2.5) has full pages for Oblivion, including Oblivion:Oblivion Remastered, Oblivion:Quests (links to the Main Quest, the four guilds, the Arena, Daedric quests, side quests, Knights of the Nine) and Oblivion:Main Quest (about 55 linked quest and place pages). Chapter structure follows those questlines; only page names were used, no text copied. Adapting UESP text later is allowed under CC BY-SA 2.5 with attribution and share-alike. No StrategyWiki page. elderscrolls.fandom.com also answers the API. The Steam schema calls the app "Jaws" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2623190 is Oblivion Remastered. Steam has no achievements for Daedric quests or Knights of the Nine, so those chapters have no collectibles yet.
